parameters.name: AgentKey
parameters.description: The key of the business space. If this parameter is not specified, the default business space is accessed. You can obtain the key value on the business management page of the Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the chatbot.

parameters.name: RecommendNum
parameters.description: The number of recommended questions. Valid values: 1 to 10. This parameter takes effect only when recommendations are returned. The number of returned recommendations does not exceed the value of RecommendNum.

parameters.name: SessionId
parameters.description: The session ID, which is used to identify a visitor session and maintain context information. For a new visitor, you do not need to specify this parameter when calling the Chat operation for the first time. The chatbot starts a session and returns the SessionId in the response. For subsequent conversation turns of the same visitor, pass the current SessionId when calling the Chat operation so that the chatbot can continue the conversation based on the SessionId.
